ios.desc:
Reminders to keep in touch and remember birthdays. Close personal relationships make life happier, healthier and longer.

STORY:

Hey everyone,

I'm Kai - the guy behind Amicu.

It’s great to catch up with someone you care about.

But it's not so easy anymore.

Your contacts are spread over many places. Mixed with people you don’t know. An avalanche of comments, posts, and texts cluttering everything up. It feels like a chore. No time for the joy of meeting up.

And life changes. You move to new places. You change jobs. You travel and meet people, but they're abroad. You join events with cool people. But months of work follow. They stop to appear in feeds and inboxes. Instead of fun reunites relationships fade.

I met people, while traveling, living abroad, and volunteering. Not all are on social media. Plus, who likes the distractions, ads, and privacy issues?

So I made Amicu. It reminds you to catch up.

You decide which people matter. After time reminders show up. Then it's your turn. Meet, call, or be creative.

And your contacts should be no one’s business. With Amicu nothing leaves your device.

That's it. No spam, privacy-invasion, customer relationships, or feeds. Simple and easy.

Ideas, Questions and Feedback: Write to me at kai@amicu.app

NOW WITH WIDGETS:
• Birthdays today
• People you're in touch with
• Due contacts
• Daily goal

BIRTHDAYS:

• See upcoming birthdays so you can prepare.
• Only shows the birthdays of added contacts. Not every birthday.
• Highlights people without birthdays. Never miss an important birthday.
• Get notifications a week before and on the birthday.

REMINDERS TO KEEP IN TOUCH:

• Add reminders how often you want to keep in touch.
• Go through your entire contacts fast. One tap per contact.
• Contact people using your favorite apps.
• Mark many people in touch at the end of the day.
• Snooze reminders, when you're busy.
• Customizable notifications for reminders
• Daily goal to reach out to someone
• Custom reminders (premium only)

MANAGE CONTACTS:

• Amicu Contacts are automatically updated, if the contact book changes.
• See contacts without email, phone, address or avatar.
• Edit contacts directly in Amicu.

STATISTICS:

• See the contact frequency for each person e.g. every 2 weeks
• Make sure to have enough time for people (premium only)
• See how social you're this week and on average (premium only)
• Find the right balance of people, reminder frequency and your time

PRIVACY AND USABILITY FRIENDLY:

• Works

quotes.text:
Monica is a nice tool, but I wanted an iOS app with great UX and privacy.

Amicu is basically SwiftUI on top of a local SQLite db. It supports tracking the last contact date, catchup reminders, birthday reminders, Siri, Shortcuts (for semi automatic workflows), and widgets. Save the main comm app per contact (WhatsApp, Telegram, FB, etc.) for batch messages like a birthday event invite.

Feedback is welcome.
